purpose: Guide original professional Christmas Jazz arrangements from high-level rhythmic and production traits.

classic_crooner_swing.reference_context: Sinatra holiday big-band and orchestral tradition
classic_crooner_swing.dynamics: intimate opening, gradual orchestral lift, never overcompressed

new_orleans_holiday_jazz.reference_context: Louis Armstrong holiday and traditional New Orleans jazz language
new_orleans_holiday_jazz.dynamics: bright and human, with controlled looseness rather than sloppy timing

modern_traditional_pop_jazz.reference_context: Michael Bublé holiday production: contemporary traditional pop, vocal jazz and swing
arrangement: big-band lift without masking the melody
modern_traditional_pop_jazz.dynamics: polished, warm and wide; preserve transient life and vocal/melodic focus

production_method.transition_rule: Crossfade only between compatible rhythmic profiles; never force swing into straight time or a two-feel into a dense four-beat groove.
production_method.quality_gate: Professional audio quality policy applies before any Christmas track can enter a video.
production_method.learning: Store accepted and rejected rhythmic features in the feedback model and retrain after every audited batch.
